Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterUtilityBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterUtilityBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterUtilityBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable caller-scenario fired-heater utility receipt for coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating.

The receipt converts the external-heating duty from a qualified thermal-duty balance to caller-owned fuel input, cost, and indirect-emissions rates. It does not select a fuel, define a lifecycle boundary, or model combustion or furnace performance.

1.0

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterUtilityBalance calculate(RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenThermalDutyBalance thermalDutyBalance, double furnaceEfficiencyFraction, double fuelLowerHeatingValueMegaJoulePerKg, double fuelCostPerKg, double fuelEmissionsKgCo2EquivalentPerKg)
      Calculate caller-owned fired-heater fuel, cost, and emissions bookkeeping.
      Parameters:
      thermalDutyBalance - qualified coupled thermal-duty receipt
      furnaceEfficiencyFraction - caller-supplied delivered-heat/fuel-LHV fraction in (0, 1]
      fuelLowerHeatingValueMegaJoulePerKg - caller-supplied fuel LHV in MJ/kg
      fuelCostPerKg - caller-supplied price in currency units per kg fuel
      fuelEmissionsKgCo2EquivalentPerKg - caller-supplied emissions factor in kg CO2e/kg fuel
      Returns:
      immutable fired-heater utility receipt
